Hi:

On Sat, Nov 17, 2012 at 2:14 PM, NewUserBD <bdne...@gmail.com> wrote:
Repeated attempts to install have failed. Other packages install without problem; Messages as follows:

package ‘ggplot2’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked

The downloaded binary packages are in
	C:\Users\Brian\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmpo7AMhw\downloaded_packages
> library (ggplot2)
Error in get(Info[i, 1], envir = env) : 
  internal error -3 in R_decompress1
In addition: Warning message:
package ‘ggplot2’ was built under R version 2.15.2 
Error: package/namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’

I have no problems loading ggplot2-0.9.2.1 in the latest version of RStudio on a Win7 OS. A couple of questions:

* Did you install ggplot2 inside of RStudio or outside of it? If you installed it inside RStudio, try reinstalling it outside of RStudio (e.g. in Rgui) and see if that makes a difference. (It shouldn't, but you never know...)
* What is your sessionInfo() ?  [If you don't know what that means, type sessionInfo() at the R prompt, cut and paste the output and insert it in your reply e-mail. If you do know, my apologies...no offense intended.]

Dennis
